label: context.reference
text:
Use Remote Operator through world_remote_operator. Project EE policy must admit it; the task needs the exact interface binding and this artifact binding. Check current remote_operator.status from its running private world for connection evidence. Installation, enabling and past pairing do not establish a live connection.

Send remote_operator.request with exact catalog ids. Pairing, ChatGPT account auth, enrollment, refresh, cursors, reconnect timing, segmentation and acknowledgements stay private to the interface. API-key auth is refused. Expose the short-lived pairing value only to the operator; do not copy it into general logs or context.

Remote input arrives as remote_operator.input with exact client, stream, sequence, cursor and transport evidence. Send output through remote_operator.deliver; confirm delivery from remote_operator.delivery's wire sequence and acknowledgement state. The interface exposes artifact-native messages, not app-server methods, thread/session ids, provider authority, hidden managers, compatibility fallbacks or runtime timers. Private wire envelopes do not determine Octopus routes.
